concretechanges.before: The card is not the entry. The entry is what happened at that node. The card just names the position so the spiral has a coordinate system.
concretechanges.after: The card names a position; the entry records an encounter and its interpretation.

concretechanges.before: The system requires all 22 positions to hold its geometry. Remove one and the entire spiral deforms.
concretechanges.after: Reading neighbouring positions can complicate a single card’s interpretation. The journal does not need to complete every position before an entry becomes worthwhile.

concretechanges.before: At the cosmic scale, the 22 cards form a universal grammar.
concretechanges.after: At the broadest scale of this house reading, I imagine the 22 cards as a grammar.

concretechanges.before: The cost is not optional; it is the price of the position. A card read without cost is a card not walked.
concretechanges.after: These costs describe interpretations in this journal; they are not requirements a reader must undergo to understand a card.

concretechanges.before: The Tower is demolition as gift. The structure that falls was holding up something false. The rubble is the record of what was built. The earthquake that said goodbye did not destroy; it revealed.
concretechanges.after: The Tower can help a journal examine rupture, but a symbolic reading cannot make an earthquake a gift or establish that a destroyed structure was false. The rubble also records material loss.

concretechanges.before: The gap is data, not deficiency. Certain positions remain vacant because the body has not arrived there. Some were inhabited but never committed to text. The hub names what exists and what does not.
concretechanges.after: The gaps describe this selection of entries. They may reflect missing writing or a different way of assigning a card; they do not establish which experiences a person has or has not lived.

concretechanges.before: The structure that has to fall before the field can show you what was holding it up. Demolition as gift.
concretechanges.after: A structure falls and exposes what had been holding it up. The entry asks what can be understood amid that loss.

concretechanges.before: The unwritten cards are fracture points. Fourteen of the twenty-two positions have no entries. This is not a problem to fix; it is information. Some positions have not been walked because the body has not been there yet. Others have been walked but the entry has not been authored. The fracture is structural, not personal. The spiral has gaps; the gaps show where the field has not yet spoken.
concretechanges.after: Fourteen positions in this selection have no entries. An empty line can mean unwritten experience, an unmade assignment or a piece still to be found. The index records the gap without pretending to know which.
